Intel Xeon E5‑2696 v4 22‑Core 2.2GHz LGA2011‑3 Server CPU Processor – High‑Performance Enterprise CPU


The Intel Xeon E5‑2696 v4 is a powerful enterprise‑grade server processor built to handle heavy multi‑threaded workloads, virtualization, data centers, and high‑performance computing tasks. With 22 cores and 44 threads, massive cache, and support for large DDR4 memory configurations, it delivers outstanding performance and reliability for demanding server environments.


Key Specifications


  • Base Clock Speed: 2.20 GHz
  • Cores / Threads: 22 Cores / 44 Threads
  • Smart Cache: 55MB L3 Cache
  • Socket: LGA2011‑3 (FCLGA2011‑3)
  • TDP: High efficiency for server workloads
  • Architecture: Intel Broadwell‑EP
  • Memory Support: DDR4 up to 2400 MHz
  • PCIe: PCIe 3.0 support for high I/O performance
